name: Marketplace Specialty
description: The list accountants pick their specialties from on their profile («التخصصات الدقيقة»). A profile stores the chosen titles in its specialties table (Marketplace Tag.label), so search and the WordPress site read them as before. Each specialty may belong to a Marketplace Category, which the app uses to group the list.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Shown to accountants and stored on profiles as written; renaming a specialty does not update profiles that already chose it.

fields.label: Is Active
fields.description: Inactive specialties can no longer be picked; profiles that already have one keep it.
